crt-on.mp3.prompt: Old CRT monitor powering on: a soft static thump, then a rising high-pitched tube whine that settles. Close, dry.

dialup.mp3.prompt: Very short retro 1200-baud modem handshake chirp, quiet and clean: two tones and a brief static burst.

thunk2.mp3.prompt: Two soft heavy metal cartridges set down on a metal plinth one after the other, dull thunks, small room.

vault.mp3.prompt: A vault lock engaging: a deep mechanical clunk and a short metallic latch.

deny-a.mp3.prompt: Retro computer terminal access-denied buzz: a short, low square-wave buzz.

deny-b.mp3.prompt: Short descending two-note error beep from an old computer terminal.

dash.mp3.prompt: Arcade hover-ship dash: a quick airy synth zip with a soft thump.

shard.mp3.prompt: Bright crystal shard pickup chime in an arcade game, short.

hit.mp3.prompt: Arcade impact hit: a short crunchy punch with a bass thump.

crt-off.mp3.prompt: CRT television switching off: a sharp electrical pop followed by a falling high-pitched whine.

flatline.mp3.prompt: Hospital ECG monitor flatline: one continuous steady electronic tone, clean, no beeps.

alert.mp3.prompt: A muted chat-app notification ping, soft, single.

refund.mp3.prompt: Coin-return clink: a few coins dropping into a metal tray.

pledge.mp3.prompt: A single heavy coin dropped into a glass jar.

lobby.mp3.prompt: Rising digital lobby chime: three ascending soft synth notes, a game reconnecting.

bounce.mp3.prompt: A soft denied thud, like a muffled door closing.

coins.mp3.prompt: Coins counted one by one onto a wooden table, quick.

radio.mp3.prompt: A short radio transmission burst: a squelch and a clean data chirp.

impact.mp3.prompt: A deep, soft cinematic impact with a subtle high shimmer tail.
